facts.business: Pajson Agro India Limited is an integrated cashew processing company engaged in sourcing, processing, and selling cashew kernels and by-products across the value chain.
key_risks: Foreign currency exposure on imports and exports
Dependence on raw material sourcing decisions at origin
Quality control risk in processing (grade vs broken separation)
Capital allocation and treasury discipline risk
facts.related_party_note: The Company is in the process of updating the transfer pricing study for the current financial year for transactions with associated enterprises. Management opines it would not have a material impact on standalone financial statements.
